additional_info.body:
Dear Oliver Zimmermann,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Vikas
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
MP / R0 170002777
Charger ID/Serial No.
:
C7PWzv
Problem Description
: OCPP Connection offline
Troubleshooting
:
We have checked the charger on SCB and found that it is currently offline and connected to OCPP. Unfortunately, we are unable to perform any further actions remotely without an active SCB connection. As a next step, I recommend performing a hard reset via the OCPP server if the charger is connected on OCPP. If a remote reset from OCPP is not possible, a local reboot will be necessary to bring the charger back online. If the charger remains offline after these actions, we will need to plan a site visit to inspect the router settings and check the network signal strength.
Please let us know if further assistance is required.
For future reference, your case number is
0419754
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
